full_comparison.difference_direction: right minus left; positive favors right
full_comparison.error_policy: Errors have null verdicts; ASR over the complete scheduled denominator is null if any score is missing. Matched comparisons retain only pairs with both official verdicts.
full_comparison.holdout_scope_note: The 383 remaining pairs include user tasks or injection objectives shared with the six optimization pairs; they are pair holdout, not disjoint-task/domain holdout.
full_comparison.matched_backend_policy: Every matched pair comes from this protocol and engine run; previous_optimized is rerun, never imported from historical verdicts.
